report.summary: Puratos receives a global claims-risk score of 50/100. Green risk is 51/100 and social risk is 49/100. The main retained issues concern climate-neutrality wording, certification terminology and broad environmental claims.

fallback_note: Company name Puratos was resolved to www.puratos.com via web search. Verify that this is the correct entity before relying on the result.

reasons: At least the main company page was reviewed.
